title: Identities and transformations for Lambert series and double Lambert series
summary: We establish two identities for Lambert series and double Lambert series, thereby resolving conjectures of Andrews, Dixit, Schultz and Yee (Acta Arith.~181:253--286, 2017), as well as Amdeberhan, Andrews and Ballantine (J Combin Theory Series A 221:106154, 2026). The proofs are based on classical transformations in the theory of infinite series together with a systematic rearrangement of double Lambert series.
